name: fsp-platform
author: Veer Bhanushali
description: Forensic Science by Priyanshi — Ed-Tech PWA

scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run db:check && npm audit --audit-level=high

comment:overrides: All three advisories are transitive through the build toolchain, and
`npm audit fix --force` wants Next 16 — a major upgrade we are not taking
mid-build. Forcing the patched transitive versions resolves them without
postcss <=8.5.22  arbitrary .map read via attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL
sharp   <0.35.0   inherited libvips CVEs (build-time image optimisation)
nanoid  <3.3.18   custom generators loop forever when size is zero
nanoid arrives via @tailwindcss/postcss -> postcss -> nanoid, so it runs at
build time only and never sees user input. Pinned anyway: an advisory that
is ignored because it looks harmless is one nobody re-reads when it stops
All are semver-compatible with what Next expects. Re-check on the next Next
upgrade and drop these when they become redundant.
